frozen_action_contract.mission_scope: exactly one survey site per decision round

frozen_rl_reward_contract.watch_item: Log dense-vs-terminal reward magnitude. One pre-declared reward-weight ablation is allowed only if the terminal term is demonstrably drowned out; it must not be selected after formal test results.

frozen_case_manifest.runtime_basis: Demu provisional benchmark measured 148.3 seconds for 120 cases x 3 planners; the frozen 180 formal reporting cases are comfortably feasible at hackathon scale.

real_context_requirement.rule: Formal training and evaluation must use versioned monitoring coordinates and the frozen R5 habitat proxy. Graph-layout coordinates or neutral habitat placeholders are forbidden for the final benchmark.

baseline_fairness_gate.evidence: The provisional R7 CSV shows Frontier and spatial Information Gain spending 6 effort units in representative cases while GNN+RL spends 18 under the same nominal budget/horizon. This can confound planner quality with resource utilization.

formal_frontier.effort_rule: fixed standard-event effort 6 when budget permits; otherwise the largest allowed effort not exceeding remaining budget
formal_frontier.reason: Frontier remains a simple interpretable site heuristic, but it is no longer structurally prevented from using the available field budget.

formal_information_gain.candidate_actions: all feasible (site, effort) pairs with effort in {1,3,6}
formal_information_gain.objective: maximize absolute expected reduction in sum of marginal occupancy entropy from the explicit spatial posterior
formal_information_gain.tie_break: higher information gain per effort, then uncertainty, belief, deterministic site id
formal_information_gain.reason: IG-per-effort as the primary objective systematically preferred effort=1 under a six-round horizon and left most budget unused; absolute IG is the stronger baseline when effort has no reward/evaluation penalty and total budget already constrains resources.

baseline_fairness_gate.acceptance_rule: Do not interpret provisional RL-vs-baseline gaps as evidence of learned planning advantage until all planners are rerun on the frozen R8 manifest with the real-site context and mandatory effort_spent reporting.

training_seed_requirement.formal_rule: Retrain all formal seeds after real-site context replacement because B/C/E world generation changes when placeholder geometry/habitat are removed.

claim_guardrail: Final results support performance on the frozen synthetic sequential-decision benchmark and robustness to tested model/q assumptions only; they do not prove field effectiveness or superiority to operators.
